name: APK Builder
desc: Claude ko APK banana sikhata hai: naya app ya tumhara project, cloud ya local build
note: Termux me gh bhi install hota hai. Pehli baar: gh auth login

name: Sequential Thinking
desc: Bade kaam ko step-by-step sochta hai
cmd: claude mcp add --scope user sequential-thinking -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking

name: Context7
desc: Libraries ke latest docs, purane code se bachata hai
cmd: claude mcp add --scope user context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp

name: Memory
desc: Sessions ke beech cheezein yaad rakhta hai
cmd: claude mcp add --scope user memory -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory

name: claude-mem
cmd: claude plugin marketplace add thedotmack/claude-mem && claude plugin install claude-mem@thedotmack
note: Bun chahiye, Termux par fail ho sakta hai

name: one-skill-to-rule-them-all
note: Command nahi pata. Plugins tab me neeche 'Apna plugin command' se chalao

name: replica-skill
note: Command nahi pata. Plugins tab me neeche 'Apna plugin command' se chalao

name: code-review
desc: 📱💻 Code ko review karta hai, bugs aur galtiyan pakadta hai
note: Pehle Marketplace me 'Official marketplace jodo' dabao

name: commit-commands
desc: 📱💻 Git commit, push aur PR ek command me
note: Pehle Official marketplace jodo. Git chahiye

name: security-guidance
desc: 📱💻 Code me security risks (keys, injection, unsafe code) pakadta hai

name: frontend-design
desc: 📱💻 Website/UI ko achha aur modern design deta hai

name: feature-dev
desc: 💻 Naya feature step-by-step banata hai, bade projects ke liye
note: Pehle Official marketplace jodo. PC par best

name: Playwright (browser)
desc: 💻 Browser chalata hai, click/test/screenshot karta hai
cmd: claude mcp add --scope user playwright -- npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest
note: Install ke baad ek baar: npx playwright install chromium. Termux par browser nahi chalta

name: Fetch (web pages)
desc: 💻📱 Web page ka content laata hai, docs aur links padhta hai
cmd: claude mcp add --scope user fetch -- uvx mcp-server-fetch
note: uv chahiye: pip install uv (Termux me bhi chal sakta hai)

name: GitHub (MCP)
desc: 💻 Repo, issues aur PR GitHub se seedha Claude ke haath me
cmd: claude mcp add --scope user github -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github
note: Pehle GitHub par token banao. Phir terminal me: claude mcp add --scope user github -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=TOKEN -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github
